description: This data set holds all sensor data collected at the UKCRIC National Green Infrastructure Facility, a full-scale living laboratory for testing green infrastructure and sustainable drainage at Newcastle University in north-east England. It covers the facility's lysimeters, an ensemble of rain gardens, a swale, a green roof and other instrumented features along Holmes Avenue by the Urban Sciences Building, for water balance, flood risk and urban heat studies. Ross Stirling, Daniel Green and colleagues published it through the Newcastle University data repository, funded by the UK Collaboratorium for Research in Infrastructure and Cities; version 3 was published on 20 September 2022. Coverage is one site, with records up to September 2022. Format and access: a 272 MB ZIP archive with a read me PDF and a video, plus a data app for plotting. Licence: CC-BY-4.0; free. Caveats: updates after 2022 are not in this version, and users should read the documentation first. It supplies observed performance for calibrating SuDS and green infrastructure models in climate adaptation studies. Related catalogue records are the Newcastle Urban Observatory and the RESILIO blue-green roofs of Amsterdam.
